newsitem.title: BELGIUM: TENNIS-HENMAN CRUISES INTO FINAL OF EC TOURNAMENT.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-HENMAN CRUISES INTO FINAL OF EC TOURNAMENT.

text.p: British number one Tim Henman reached his third final of the year when he beat unseeded Marc Goellner 6-4 6-4 in the European Community tournament on Saturday.
Henman's opponent in the final will be former Olympic champion Marc Rosset of Switzerland or Czech Petr Korda who were meeting in the second semifinal.

Henman, the world number 19 who won his first professional title in Sydney last month, broke Goellner in the opening game after the German double-faulted twice and then held his serve to seal the first set in 35 minutes.
He broke again in the opening game of the second set after another Goellner double fault.
Goellner made amends with a service break in the next game but Henman broke again in the fifth game and never looked in danger of losing control.
He served out the match with a love game after one hour 10 minutes.
